row.notes: Strategy wetness forecast: integrates the track-wetness change over a look-ahead window. param_2 = {steps (float, rounded down), step length, start offset}. For each step samples the wetness at weather time t (active slot byte [[self+0x10]+0x20]+0x26c4, stride 0x288: (t0 + t1) * scale + offset*scale) through FUN_140b12c10 on the weather curve ([[self+0x10]+0x28]+0xd48 + slot*0x30), or the current surface wetness [[[self+0x10]+0x90]+0xf48]+0x3f0a38 when the offset is 0 and no forced weather (+0xb42b/+0xb42c); sums the deltas, adds the fractional last step, returns current + total delta. Callers 0x1436a3b83, 0x1436a67d7, 0x1436a69ca (AI tyre strategy). (used by vmknolle wet-track: AI pit decisions follow addon wetness) | re-bindings 2026-11-18: Steam 1.0.145 (sigport --witness): 0x1436a6a90, 147/147 equal, with all 3 uses of +0x3f0a38 at the same instructions.
